objects.name: Detection technique coverage: gcp-unusual-number-of-failed-authentications-from-ip
objects.description: The following analytic identifies a single source IP failing to authenticate into Google Workspace with multiple valid users, potentially indicating a Password Spraying attack. It uses Google Workspace login failure events and calculates the standard deviation for source IPs, applying the 3-sigma rule to detect unusual failed authentication attempts.
